text:
alana: FYI flipped tenant `zephyr` to v2-prefer (2% canary) at 08:40 PT. console shows a short v1 token bump despite router traces showing chosen_route=v2. anyone on routing/telemetry?

console-bot: change detected: tenant=zephyr v2_prefer=true @2025-03-10T15:40:00Z. note: dashboards aggregate by billing_meter_key by default.

deepa: seeing it. router trace sample: chosen_route=v2, billing log for same req ids shows meter_key=v1 for ~90s. billing memo cache likely stale.

mike: did we enable sticky pins? those can surface fallbacks long after a flip.

siva: pin.ttl=300s for this tenant. that, plus billing memo_ttl=5m, explains the mismatch window.

alana: short-term fix: i'll set pin.ttl=0 for zephyr. can we also reduce billing memo ttl for canary tenants to 30s?

deepa: opsbot can flip pin. siva, can you stage a billing hotfix to lower memo ttl for `zephyr` pattern?

siva: will open PR to add per-tenant override and a pubsub invalidation on tenant-routing:update. staging deploy in 15m.

opsbot: prod-config-change: pin.ttl(zephyr)=0 applied by alana @2025-03-10T15:42:05Z.

mike: UX/ops note: add a dismissible toast on route toggles: "Billing attribution may lag up to 2 minutes due to caching" and expose chart toggle "show by chosen route / show by billing key". avoids PM confusion.

deepa: agree. analytics: add `last_billing_sync_age` metric per tenant and suppress quota alerts when recent route-change and sync_age>60s.

alana: thanks. metrics re-aligned ~80s after pin change + early invalidation. i'll file a tiny RFC linking the PR and toast mock. owners: siva infra, deepa analytics, mike UX. closing after RFC posted. :thumbsup:
